sources.note: Inspected owner-supplied villa-corazon-elementary-school.png on 2026-10-08; capture date unknown. URL locates the site. Compact courtyard gap west of the eastern classroom row, small separate courtyard plants and east fence-edge crowns. The bright white/green roofs remain roofs. No broad grass or identifiable hedge; the dark roof-edge bands are shadows. Central red roof and eastern classroom row; western mapped roof extends farther than clearly visible white roof in this reference. Independent excluded check errors: 1.70 m, 3.97 m. Visible crown centers are fitted to clear trunks within the observed crown footprint (maximum seven metres); crowns may overhang roofs and roads. Crown widths in the dense belts are estimated from image pixels against their matched local roof scale; existing circular crowns approximate irregular/elliptical image crowns. Complete mapped roofs, pitches, full-width paths/roads, water and farmland remain unchanged. Planted islands take precedence over exposed paving; ground under opaque canopy is not invented. No surveyed boundary, species, construction date or exact inventory inferred; no bitmap ships.
